ZBU Season 1 Airdrop: Official Distribution Timeline & Claim Details POSTED BY : Zeebu DAte : April 8, 2025 To everyone who’s been with us from day one, thank you. Your belief in Zeebu and our mission to reshape B2B settlements through decentralized finance has brought us to this moment. From the early vision of a seamless, blockchain-powered payment network to launching the ZBU Protocol and watching a vibrant community rally around it, your contributions have laid the foundation for a future where enterprise-grade DeFi is truly community-owned. And now, the moment you’ve been waiting for is here: We’re thrilled to announce the official dates and distribution structure for the Season 1 ZBU Airdrop tiers—the first major wave of rewards for early supporters, power users, and protocol participants. But before we dive into what's next, let’s recap what made Season 1 so great 👇 The Waitlist Phase: Where It All Began In July 2024, we opened the gates to the ZBU Protocol Waitlist, offering early access to the next frontier in decentralized liquidity and real-world DeFi. Thousands of users signed up, staking their claim in the future of telecom-powered blockchain innovation. The Early Phase closed on November 15, 2024, and we began Sybil verification of all waitlist entries. This initial round of gratitude was sent out to: 53,411 early users Total USD value distributed: $332,843.625 Total ZBU airdropped: 66,568.72 ZBU ZBU Airdrop Season 1: Launch & Distribution Following the successful conclusion of the waitlist, we officially kicked off Season 1 of the ZBU Airdrop with a staggering 60 million ZBU tokens to reward protocol participants for their contributions. Season 1 introduced a tier-based structure that rewarded users based on their depth of engagement—from simple SocialFi actions to advanced staking and governance. Tier Breakdown & Task Structure Here’s how the Season 1 rewards were structured: Tier Tasks ZBU Allocation Blue SocialFi + Holding 1,000,000 ZBU Silver SocialFi + Staking 4,000,000 ZBU Gold Node Staking + Delegation 10,000,000 ZBU Platinum Node Activation + Governance Participation 45,000,000 ZBU Users could upgrade tiers by completing more tasks, inviting high-tier participants, or accumulating ZIPs (Zeebu Impact Points) via financial engagement and staking actions like VeZBU or VeLP. ZIP Farming Snapshot As part of Season 1, participants across all tiers actively engaged in earning Zeebu Impact Points (ZIPs) through protocol-related activities. Below is a tier-wise breakdown of user participation and ZIP accumulation: 55,790 users achieved the Blue Tier, collectively farming 4.08 billion ZIPs 126 users achieved the Silver Tier, collectively farming 7.57 billion ZIPs 23 users achieved the Gold Tier, collectively farming 21.78 billion ZIPs 58 users achieved the Platinum Tier, collectively farming 3.69 trillion ZIPs Total ZIPs Farmed: 3.72 trillion Total Unique Participants: 58,680 Please note: These figures represent data as of the time of writing. Final values may be subject to change upon completion of verification and reward calculations. Airdrop Season 1: Key Milestones & Claim Timeline We’re excited to share the ZBU Season 1 Airdrop distribution schedule. Please review the dates below to ensure you don’t miss your eligibility window: March 31, 2025 – Final Entry Deadline The window for new participants officially closed. Only users who joined before this date are eligible for Season 1. April 10, 2025 – ZIP Farming Ends Silver, Gold, and Platinum Tier members can continue earning ZIP points until this date. April 11, 2025 – Blue Tier Claims Open Verified Blue Tier participants may begin claiming their allocated airdrop rewards. Opens After April 15 – Silver, Gold & Platinum Claims Begin Eligible participants in higher tiers will be able to claim their rewards based on final ZIP point allocations after April 15. Where Will You Receive Your Airdrop? Your eligible ZBU airdrop will be distributed to the wallet address linked to your Zeebu.fi account. Claiming will be available through the official Zeebu.fi Airdrop portal , where you’ll find your tier status, claimable amount, and history. Final Airdrop Calculations Final reward amounts have been calculated based on completed tasks, tier status, and contribution. What’s Next for ZBU? With Season 1 airdrops rolling out, Zeebu is only getting started. Coming up: Innovative New Launches Strategic Partnerships Network Expansion ZBU Protocol Upgrades And of course—Season 2 is right around the corner. Swing by Zeebu.fi today and claim your daily ZIPs.
